messages:
Luca M.: Heads-up: just routed an EU data subject request — user requests full erasure of chats + any derived embeddings and wants a signed proof pack. ReqID: EU-26-777.

Tom W.: Is this a hosted account or tied to a dedicated/private instance? KMS handling differs.

Priya S.: Hosted account on prod. user id uid_zz_top. No tenant sharing. However they mentioned an old demo transcript that might live in a demo workspace — need to confirm cross-workspace refs.

kms-bot: Key mapping: embeddings-store -> platform-key:v3 (symmetric, managed by Redwood KMS). Snapshots encrypted with snapshot-key-2024.

Tom W.: Good. For platform keys we can perform object-level deletes. For any snapshots encrypted with snapshot-key-2024 we must ensure we don't accidentally rotate the key (that would destroy data irreversibly).

Anya (Legal): Legal asks: do not rotate customer or platform keys for deletion proof unless legal explicitly okays key destruction. We prefer explicit deletion traces and signed manifests over key destruction. Audit retention policy: export delete ops and retain raw audit lines for 180 days.

SecOps: Ops note: backups exist in cold-storage for 90 days then archive to vault-archives for an additional 12 months. If requester requires deletion from all backups within 30 days we need a retention-exception flow or proof that archive copies don't contain PII.

Helga (Product): Product is requesting we keep aggregate anonymized telemetry (event counts only) for model quality. Legal: any retained telemetry must be irreversibly anonymized and documented.

Priya S.: Proposed erasure plan:
1) Create ephemeral role `dsar-operator-EU26` with narrow scope (target uid only), TTL 4h.
2) Run preflight: identify objects, embeddings, snapshots. Produce manifest (store in gs://compliance/dsar/EU-26-777/dryrun.json).
3) Canary: delete a single vector shard and verify no index rebuild re-ingests data.
4) Pause snapshot and snapshot-export jobs in EU region.
5) Execute full deletion across object-store, vector-store, and metadata DB.
6) Export raw audit lines for delete ops, sign manifest, hand to Legal.

Tom W.: +1 to canary. Also we need a replication sweep in region-eu to ensure replicas don't rehydrate rows. SQL sanity check I propose: `SELECT count(*) FROM embeddings WHERE user_id='uid_zz_top';` before/after.

Priya S.: Draft manifest schema (legal-friendly):
[
  {
    "object_path": "gs://redwood-prod/users/uid_zz_top/chat-001.json",
    "object_id": "chat-001",
    "storage_type": "object-store",
    "kms_key_id": "snapshot-key-2024",
    "derived_from": ["chat-001"],
    "derivation_chain": "embeddings-v1->index-shard-42",
    "deletion_ts": "2026-05-02T09:12:00Z",
    "method": "delete-api",
    "operator": "Priya S.",
    "proof_sig": "pgp:0xFACEBEEF...",
    "proof_hash": "sha256:deadbeef..."
  }
]

Anya (Legal): Schema looks acceptable. Please add an explicit `scope` field (e.g., hosted/dedicated) and `request_id` in each entry. We'll need the operator's role in the signed statement too.

SecOps: Note: vector DB has tombstone GC window of 48h by default; deletion job must perform tombstone compaction to remove vectors — otherwise someone could query tombstone rows. We'll run compaction after deletion.

infra-bot: Workflow ticket created: DSAR-3500. JIT RBAC request created: RBAC-3500.

Priya S.: I'll open RBAC PR and the dry-run manifest in the compliance bucket. PR will auto-attach to DSAR-3500.

deploy-bot: RBAC PR #DSAR-3500 opened by priya. Reviewers: TomW, SecOps.

Helga (Product): If Legal allows, Product requests a retention exception to keep anonymized counts for 12 months. Will prepare a data-minimization spec for review.

Anya (Legal): Retention exception only if: (1) data is aggregated beyond re-identification thresholds, (2) documented purpose, (3) TTL enforced and reviewed by privacy. We'll review Helga's spec.

Priya S.: Canary scheduled in 45m. I'll pause snapshot-export job once canary is green. Reminder: do not rotate keys.

Tom W.: After canary, run the replication sweep and tombstone compaction. Also export audit-lines: `gsutil cp /var/log/audit/delete-lines-DSAR-3500.gz gs://compliance/dsar/EU-26-777/`

Luca M.: Action items recap:
- Priya: create ephemeral RBAC + run dry-run manifest + canary.
- Tom: replication sweep + compaction checks.
- SecOps: ensure backups/archives are reviewed and mark any archive deletion tasks.
- Anya: sign manifest once ops attaches proof and operator signature.
- Helga: submit anonymized telemetry spec if retention requested.

Priya S.: Target: canary in 45m, full erase after validation (aim EOD). Will update DSAR tracker.

Luca M.: Thanks everyone. Keep this channel for blockers only.
